equity.level_reason: Racial disparity in TB incidence is framed ('represents an ongoing health disparity'), quantified ('at least 10 times higher' for AI/AN and NH/OPI persons than White persons, cited from earlier work) and interpreted. No social determinant is named as explaining the racial gap.

level_alternative.reason: Congregate settings and resources diverted to COVID-19 control are named as explanations for TB among persons experiencing homelessness or incarcerated, which a broad reading treats as level 4.

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is missing for 175 cases in 2022 (Table 2 note); the 10-fold ratio is from an earlier analysis (ref 2), not computed here; small groups such as non-U.S.-born AI/AN persons are volatile (article footnote).

notes: Incidence per 100,000 and percentages are the measures; percent change is arithmetic and Census denominators are not procedures, so procedures is empty. No test, CI, adjustment or regression is reported, so inference is none. The 'at least 10 times higher' ratio is cited from earlier work and is context only.
